integrity: Executable standalone arithmetic and geometric verifier; finite enumeration is exhaustive within this domain; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to smooth plane-filling binary quintics; classification via exact finite-field enumeration; Lomont 2002 earlier enumerated all binary plane curves degree <=5, and its complete archived counts are a residual originality risk. title: Distinct zeta functions for all smooth binary plane-filling quintics
